تحتازون (form VIII)
# تَحْتَازُونَ (taḥtāzūna) /taħ.taː.zuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَازَ (iḥtāza)
# تُحْتَازُونَ (tuḥtāzūna) /tuħ.taː.zuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَازَ (iḥtāza)
